instructions: Exercise record for Provectus Alternative D. The originals remain at manifest.template.json and README.template.md. No credentials. Pending means not chosen yet. not-exportable means a detail was unavailable and was not replaced with a guess.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Cursor 3.23.23, user-reported and not rechecked in this session. Coding-model display name, user-reported and not independently confirmed: Grok 4.7 High. This is not a verified API model ID. Reasoning: High, selected by the user. Python 3.12.14 with an existing .venv, user-reported and not rechecked in this session. Planning assistance is recorded in docs/work-log.md as ChatGPT, without an API model ID. The display name ChatGPT-6.1 Sol High is user-reported and not independently confirmed; it is not a verified API model ID. pytest 9.1.1 is recorded in requirements-dev.txt from the version installed into .venv. Provider API model IDs, temperature, and output limits were not exported. No defaults for those parameters are known, so none are recorded. The user may switch the coding model later for cost; that change has not happened.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: ChatGPT's GitHub connector was attempted during planning. It returned Not Found and made no repository changes. Version and permissions were not provided. The same attempt is recorded as the ChatGPT GitHub connector under tool_and_mcp_settings. That connector is not a Cursor extension. The Cursor extension inventory was not exported and is unavailable; this does not claim that Cursor has zero extensions.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Application Responses API model specified for this exercise: gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14. temperature 0, max_output_tokens 1500, store false, parallel_tool_calls false. Client timeout 20 seconds and max_retries 0. openai 3.24.0 and its installed dependencies are pinned in requirements.txt. No live API call was made. Tests use mocks and save response_source mock. SQL errors, timeouts, and truncation stay incomplete. Evidence IDs are investigation-scoped.

skills.notes: No project skills were created or used.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: Repository-root AGENTS.md holds the project instructions. No subagents were defined.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No hooks or scripts were added. Nothing runs automatically for this exercise.

prompts_and_rules.notes: 001-bootstrap.md is the saved bootstrap instruction. 002-sql-tool.md is the saved query-tool instruction. 003-sql-review.md is the saved review-fix instruction. 004-agent-loop.md is the saved agent instruction. investigator/prompts/investigation.md is the application prompt sent to the model. workflow-example.md records the query-tool review correction. The pre-review query tool is snapshots/query-tool-before-review.py.txt. AGENTS.md is the project instruction file. data/domain.md remains the domain source of truth and is not copied here.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: ChatGPT's GitHub connector was asked to read this repository, returned Not Found, and made no repository changes. Its version and permissions were not provided. The same attempt is acknowledged under plugins_and_extensions. It is not a Cursor extension, and no Cursor MCP configuration was exported or added. The Cursor extension inventory remains unavailable.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Live investigate and follow-up commands read OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment, or from the repository-root .env when the variable is unset. An existing value is not replaced. Replay does not load .env. The key value is not stored. No permission settings were exported. .gitignore excludes .env and .venv.
